headline: Public hearing on commercial redevelopment at 500 Easthampton Road, plus enforcement orders at 233 Easthampton Road and 5 Appleton Street.
summary: Other items include a MassDEP discussion, updates on the conservation planner and city forester positions, and a going-away luncheon for Maggie Herlihy. The meeting will also cover upcoming items for the September 10 meeting.
items: Public hearing on Notice of Intent DEP WE# 186-0306 for commercial redevelopment within the buffer zone of bordering vegetated wetlands at 500 Easthampton Road, continued from March 26, 2026
Enforcement order at 233 Easthampton Road for soil grading, mounding, and rutting across about 25,000 square feet, continued from June 25, 2026
Enforcement order at 5 Appleton Street for grading and fill along about 470 lineal feet of banks near the Connecticut River, continued from August 13, 2026
Discussion on updates for the Conservation Planner and City Forester positions
Discussion on a going-away luncheon for Maggie Herlihy
Discussion on upcoming items for the 9/10/26 meeting

## Holyoke Conservation Commission

August 27th, 2026
6:15 PM

This meeting will be held remotely, in accordance with temporary changes to Open Meeting Law. Access to this meeting is available to the public by computer or phone as follows:

- Computer Access: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/89934115730?pwd=Lub32w5G4BBZZqjea7r4wDj3ZRPl0e.1
- Phone Access: Call +1 301-715-8592 and enter the Meeting ID followed by: 899 3411 5730

Contact Maggie Herlihy for questions about meeting access: herlihym@holyoke.org or 413-322-5615

1. Call to Order (All meetings are recorded)
2. Public Hearing – Notice of Intent DEP WE# 186-0306 – Continued from 3/26/26
   - Applicant: Salmar Realty, Inc.
   - Representative: R. Levesque Associates
   - Location: 500 Easthampton Road (MBP: 213-00-003, 212-00-001)
   - Description: Commercial redevelopment within the Buffer Zone of Bordering Vegetated Wetlands
3. Enforcement Order – Continued from 6/25/26
   - Location: 233 Easthampton Road (MBP: 141-00-002)
   - Description: Soil grading, mounding and rutting from heavy equipment usage across approximately 25,000 square feet of undeveloped land within the 100 foot Buffer Zone of Banks and Bordering Vegetated Wetlands.
4. Enforcement Order – Continued from 8/13/26
   - Location: 5 Appleton Street (MBP: 049-01-006)
   - Description: Grading and fill deposition along approximately 470 lineal feet of banks within Riverfront, Banks, and Priority and Estimated Habitats of Rare Species associated with the Connecticut River. Fill sediments and associated debris were observed eroding down the steep bank towards the water.
5. Discussion – MassDEP Engagement
6. Discussion – Updates regarding the Conservation Planner and City Forester positions
7. Discussion – Going away luncheon for Maggie Herlihy
8. Formal Vote – Minutes from 5/14/26 Meeting
9. Discussion – Upcoming Items for 9/10/26 Meeting
10. Mail/other items not reasonably anticipated by the Chair
11. Adjourn

Received by Holyoke City Clerk: AUG 24 2026
